description: This file defines kernel package configurations for the Linux kernel build system related to the Freescale QorIQ hardware, including support for AHCI SATA and PPFE driver modules. It specifies metadata, dependencies, file paths, and auto-loading rules for these kernel modules.

methods.name: KernelPackage/ahci-qoriq
methods.description: Defines the QorIQ AHCI SATA support kernel package with related options and dependencies.

methods.name: KernelPackage/ppfe
methods.description: Defines the Freescale PPFE Driver support kernel package with associated options and dependencies.
